subject: Security intake: telemetry sample access & SOC 2 Q&A coordination
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@kintera-health.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: security@kintera-health.com, bob.lang@kintera-health.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 intake + telemetry/metric samples — proposed timeline

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. Kintera is ready to start the SOC 2 intake and we want to make sure the telemetry/log samples you need are scoped correctly before the call. A few asks up front:

- Which log types do you need for the dry-run (app logs, API gateway, worker-side traces, audit logs)?
- Minimum timeframe you require (7 days, 30 days)? We can provision a 30-day export but it's larger.
- Are you able to accept redacted PII in the samples? We can provide tokenized fields.

Would Wednesday or Thursday this week work for a 45-minute intake? Our security lead (Bob) prefers Thurs after 1pm PT.

I've attached our completed questionnaire draft (kintera-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx) for your review.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Security Program Manager
Kintera Health

Attachments: kintera-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx (42 KB)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@kintera-health.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 intake + telemetry/metric samples — proposed timeline

Hi Alice — thanks for the questionnaire and context. Thursday 17 Mar after 1pm PT works for us; putting a 45-minute slot on the calendar for 1:30pm PT now.

Quick answers to your questions so your team can prepare:

- Priority logs: API gateway access logs, application error logs, and audit trails from the control plane. If you have distributed traces (open-telemetry) that show request flow, that helps for incident mapping but isn't mandatory for the dry-run.
- Minimum timeframe: 14 days is ideal for spotting retention/rotation behaviors; we can work with 7 days if exporting 14 is difficult.
- Redaction: tokenized/redacted PII is fine; include a short mapping file describing fields removed.

I've attached our intake runbook (redwood-soc2-intake-runbook.pdf) which outlines sample naming conventions, recommended log formats (JSON/NDJSON preferred), and secure upload options (pre-signed S3 or SFTP). We'll ask for a one-off upload for the dry-run; for the audit we can discuss longer-term ingestion.

Action items before Thurs:
- Kintera: pick 7–14 day window and confirm where you'll export logs from (S3, internal archive, or SIEM).
- Kintera: confirm whether you can produce a tokenization mapping file for redacted fields.
- Redwood: we'll prepare a minimum-runbook checklist and a short demo of sample validation during the call.

See calendar invite. Looking forward to the sync.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-intake-runbook.pdf (160 KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@kintera-health.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Intake checklist + sample payload conventions (pre-call)

Hi Alice, Marcus —

Adding a short checklist that we'll walk through at the top of the intake call. I've also included a tiny sample archive with anonymized logs so the Kintera team can compare formatting.

Pre-call checklist (we'll mark these during the call):
- [ ] Confirm log sources (API GW, app, control-plane audit, auth provider).
- [ ] Confirm retention window for the sample export (7/14/30 days).
- [ ] Confirm redaction/tokenization approach and provide mapping file.
- [ ] Upload path chosen (S3 presign / SFTP / secure Share).
- [ ] Identify Kintera owner for follow-up evidence (name + email).

Sample format notes:
- Preferred: NDJSON, each line a discrete event with timestamp in ISO8601.
- Include request_id or trace_id when possible to stitch events.
- Remove full PII fields and include a mapping CSV describing transformations.

Attachment stub: redwood-logs-sample.tar.gz — contains examples/ndjson/api-2026-03-01.ndjson (2.3MB) and mapping_example.csv

If Kintera can upload the sample ahead of time (even a partial 7-day subset), we can validate it within 24 hours and surface any format issues during the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-logs-sample.tar.gz (3.2MB)
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@kintera-health.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: bob.lang@kintera-health.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake: telemetry sample access & SOC 2 Q&A coordination

Thanks — appreciate the runbook and checklist. Bob and I confirmed:

- We'll export API gateway + app error logs + auth/audit logs for a 14-day window (2026-02-28 to 2026-03-13) and provide a tokenization mapping CSV.
- We'll upload via pre-signed S3 links; security@kintera will send links to marissa@redwood by EOD.
- Our evidence owner for the intake is Bob Lang (bob.lang@kintera-health.com).

For the call: we'll cover the questionnaire points you flagged and go through the sample validation steps. If you need any additional detail pre-call, please flag it.

Onboarding notes for Redwood team: please check the attached high-level questionnaire answers we added (sheet 1) — we'll finish the remaining sheets after your intake.

See you at 1:30pm PT tomorrow.

Best,
Alice Chen
Security Program Manager
Kintera Health
